purpose: Fill the B10 acknowledged direct paired comparison gap; strengthen evidence by testing the claim, not by requiring favorable results
timing: Post-hoc plan fixed before new intervals were computed, after rounded system point estimates were already known; not prospective preregistration
contrast: full R11 minus natural CORAL with the same DeiT and fold-wise selected fusion
interpretation_focus: QWK and MAE; all six outcomes reported with no favorable-outcome selection

bootstrap.undefined_replicates: count and exclude from finite percentile calculations, never replace with zero

descriptive_support: six metrics by the five original outer folds
paired correct/incorrect transitions and absolute-grade-error changes
verification: reproduce the six already reported system point estimates
independent sklearn check of points and first eight actual patient bootstrap draws
inference_boundary: conditional on fitted models and frozen choices
one seed and reused development cohort
intervals do not include retraining or model-selection uncertainty
fold counts descriptive, not five independent trials
interval crossing zero is not equivalence or proof of no effect
